why: Drops the SESSION half of the contextual pause exit, so every paused session -- a campaign run mid-level, a versus match, a session that has not stated its kind yet -- offers to "End Practice". This is the mutation the practice assertion alone cannot see: it satisfies the new label test and is wrong everywhere else, which is exactly why that test ships with a control that pauses a campaign, a versus match and a null status through the same driver. Campaign is the case the generic word is TRUE for, and versus is issue #279's screen, so both are copy the player would act on.
